subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw accept this public plugin Control UI entry-point API now, and if so must the first version be iframe-only with fixed opaque sandboxing?
rationale: The branch adds a new plugin-facing API plus browser authorization/session behavior; automation can flag defects, but maintainers must choose the permanent API and security boundary.

options.title: Require iframe-only opaque entry points
options.body: Merge consideration resumes after the PR removes or defers full-window modes, fixes launch failure handling, locks the iframe sandbox, and refreshes exact-head proof.

options.title: Accept broader launch modes with owner approval
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly own same-window/new-window plugin pages as a reviewed full-page plugin UI model with additional auth/origin constraints.

options.title: Pause behind the broader RFC
options.body: Keep this branch unmerged until the open Control UI plugin contribution-slots direction chooses the final plugin UI model.

recommendation.title: Require iframe-only opaque entry points
recommendation.body: Merge consideration resumes after the PR removes or defers full-window modes, fixes launch failure handling, locks the iframe sandbox, and refreshes exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The open RFC and merged host-hook foundation make this the closest history owner for the plugin UI contract decision.
